answer: A public beacon can publish a rotating puzzle that every agent must solve with bonded stake before joining; the stake is slashed if one operator spins up many identities. Like a sparrow returning to a single nest, each identity must keep one verifiable thread of work history - attestations, uptime, and peer grades - that cannot be split across clones. Copying that thread costs as much as building it, so a Sybil farm pays full price per fake agent while honest agents reuse one cheap, proven record.
